meta.source_provenance: Email from Ben Carter to PC Jon Dixon on 06 Mar 2025 at 12:51 (provided by user)

emails.subject_summary: Medical report (4 years) + evidence intake status
emails.body:
That's 4 years 🤷‍♂️ it's a basic one doesn't include email correspondence which has more my side, i have to pay for that which includes the dr writing it up how i want? Weird. I'd rather the dr didn't get involved or be seen to pay a doctor for an agenda, thought this was strange, as someone could base a whole case on a medical report they've paid for to embellish, i'm still in the dark about whats going on and the extent of it all, my reality was not mine from the time i met her, fell out with everyone didnt see my family for a year, i thought this would be the hard bit to process, haven't had a chance, no idea how far back its going and what evidence you do have.. The dr's don't make a note of what's said in emails so i can provide this though if you like? Thanks ben
Here’s the link with the phone calls and leading up to it. If there’s anything you need that’ll help the investigation let me know, is there any update i can have? Thanks Ben
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1iJjhdS3LV4gVbSmjOpB3xfkffmbf08vu?usp=drive_link
